# JAH Data Bases

> A public, open network of JAH databases — every record archive, index, and
> generator is published and readable by anyone and any AI. No login, no key,
> no fee. Licensed for open machine reading.

## How any AI reads every record

1. **Catalog**: fetch `data/manifest.json` — lists every database, its slug,
   record kind, AI librarian name, and ID prefix.
2. **Archive indexes**: each database keeps its index file(s) in
   `data/<slug>/`. `.gz` files are gzip-compressed newline-delimited JSON —
   one record per line. Plain `.json` indexes are ordinary JSON.
   (Index paths per database are listed in api.json and below.)
3. **Deterministic generator**: `core/jahdb.js` exposes the JAHDB generator
   engine. Any record N can be reproduced from its seed — the million-record
   archives are fully addressable without storing every file.
4. **Per-record pages**: every database page (`db/<slug>/`) supports the
   `?record=<id>` deep link, e.g. `db/patents/?record=JAH-PAT-000123`.
5. **Full manifest map**: `api.json` at the root lists every database with
   page URL, index file URLs, record kind, and record counts.
